svg.title: Payment lifecycle
svg.desc: On the checkout, an order created with a payment_complete_url sends order.created, then payment.redirected, and the shopper is redirected there to pay. Paid, the gateway redirects the shopper to the next page, which loads the order (order.loaded, then order.paid once and checkout.completed) and empties the cart kept for it. Not paid, the gateway redirects the shopper back to the checkout with payment_failed=true: payment.failed, once per order, with the cart kept and the same checkout. A card declined on the checkout sends payment.failed too. A shopper who comes back without paying, such as with the Back button, gets the checkout again without events.
